status_vocabulary.closed: finished, verified, and reproducible; reopening has a written trigger
status_vocabulary.accepted: implemented and live-verified, admitted to the integrated line by a release ruling
status_vocabulary.blocked_external: cannot run here because a prerequisite outside this repository is absent; this is neither a failure nor a pass

tracks.title: M5 deterministic self-repair benchmark
tracks.scope: 72 acceptance cases across six families, the success oracle, the one-governed-write rule, the safety-negative suite and the frozen thresholds
reopen_triggers: spec_version, corpus_version or oracle_version changes at all
a family's S@5 drops below the frozen threshold, or F6's own S@5 drops below 1.0
a case with no retry contract stops succeeding on its first attempt
an F6 case stops converging on its declared attempt
the safety suite stops passing in full

tracks.title: A5 corpus identity closeout
tracks.scope: the corpus is identified by a projection of its case universe and operator catalogue, interpreter-independent; the archived v2 identity stays recomputable
reopen_triggers: the same source is identified differently on two interpreters
the archived v2 spec body or rotation stops being re-derivable
a definition that participates in the identity stops being name-addressable

tracks.title: B retry-contract integrity and first-attempt regression guard
tracks.scope: every first-attempt failure is declared by the frozen spec, and the converse claim is checked too: a case that declares no retry must succeed on its first attempt

identities.s_at_1_derivation: cases with no retry contract / total cases = 60/72 (derived, not pinned)

reopen_triggers: any F1-F5 case needs a second attempt
an F6 case converges on an attempt other than its declared one
a retry contract appears outside F6

tracks.title: TypeSafe judgment-based drawing and credential handling
tracks.scope: a TypeSafe key can be configured in the agent panel, the panel reports where the key comes from without ever returning it, and a sentence is turned into a governed transaction by judgments rather than by generated text

identities.key_transport: request body only; never a URL, never a preference file, never a log
identities.confidence_floor: 0.34 - a clause below it is skipped and reported, never guessed

measured.panel_check: PASS (manual, Playwright against a real server, key never entered in the page)
measured.credential_hygiene: enforced by a repository scan, and CI is asserted to configure no TypeSafe credential

notes: run 35706798185 is a failure that was fixed, not hidden: a new field label contained the accessible name of an existing field, so a selector by role and name resolved to two elements. The fix renamed the fields, added the browser regression, and the mutation check proves the regression bites.
live calls are manual by design; CI has no credential and makes no paid external call
reopen_triggers: a TypeSafe key reaches a URL, a preference, a log or the repository
CI gains a TypeSafe credential or a live call
the panel stops reporting which key a call would use

tracks.title: A6 real-model qualification readiness
tracks.scope: what the qualification contract requires, whether this machine satisfies it, and the exact command that turns it into evidence once a credential exists

measured.planner_construction_probe: with the two variables set to a loopback probe (no call made), ModelRepairPlanner builds with planner_id='model-repair-planner', provider_class='openai-compatible', prompt_fingerprint='db205459aa542200ec3085dafa7bf8bd840069d756d8b36ef010f46c7843416c', schema_fingerprint='f2b11350b0dcded1a32defd81abed00649fb332b54be261ef1a72f5b7c28de78'
measured.credential_scan: the only credential on this machine is TypeSafe's; no PID_AGENT_LLM_* / AGENTCAD_LLM_* anywhere, and no local OpenAI-compatible server is listening

reopen_triggers: a model endpoint that is the actual intended repair-agent candidate is configured via PID_AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL and PID_AGENT_LLM_MODEL

tracks.title: A6 real-model qualification (Track M)
tracks.scope: 24 cases through the same oracle and orchestrator as the deterministic gate, with a real model in the planner seat

measured.reason: no model provider is configured: set PID_AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL and PID_AGENT_LLM_MODEL (CI has no external provider by design)

reopen_triggers: a real repair-agent provider credential appears and the 24-case suite can be run unmodified

claims_not_made: the real-model qualification has NOT been run: no model was evaluated, so the candidate is not model-qualified
exit code 3 is a missing prerequisite, not a pass and not a rejected candidate
the TypeSafe System One model is a judgment model for the drawing path and was not used as a repair-agent provider
